reason: ₹22,000 is most of a month's family income and every rupee right now is going to the wedding fund. Even ₹2,000 a month for a year is a new bill I can't take on just so a washer finishes when the light goes; we can wait for the power or wash by hand.
objection: It costs nearly double a plain semi-automatic in the shop, and I'm not sure a cold wash on battery will actually get muddy farm clothes clean, so I'd be paying extra for something we'd still have to redo by hand.
would_change_my_mind: If the price came down close to an ordinary semi-automatic, around ₹12,000-13,000, with a lower EMI like ₹800-1,000 a month, and a neighbour showed me it cleans muddy clothes properly.
